_note: Market data per property location. 'rent_basis' is the honest provenance of the rent figure, which is the single most important input after price. 'researched' means a published median for this exact city or ZIP was found; 'regional_proxy' means it was reasoned from comparable Houston-exurb markets and is an assumption, not a finding.

P01.label: Farmersville, TX 75442 (Collin Co.)
P01.rent_note: No Farmersville rent median was obtainable. Collin County is the strongest rental market in this set on income and jobs, so 2,150 is used; this is an assumption.
P01.university: None nearby; ~20 mi to McKinney, UT-Dallas ~30 mi
P01.jobs: Strong - Collin County is one of the fastest-growing job markets in Texas (Plano/Frisco/McKinney corridor)
P01.flood: Inland; near Lavon Lake. No coastal surge exposure.
P01.weather: North Texas - hail is the dominant insured peril; freeze risk (Feb 2021 precedent)
P01.notes: Furthest from Houston of the whole set. Lakehaven sits off US-380 outside McKinney.

P02.label: Angleton, TX 77515 (Brazoria Co.)
P02.rent_note: Realtor.com puts the 77515 median rent at $1.9K/mo; the city-level median is also $1.8K with 23.12% YoY growth reported. Median x 1.15 size premium = $2,185.
P02.university: None; Brazosport College ~25 mi, UH main ~45 mi
P02.jobs: Petrochemical corridor - Freeport/Dow and the Port of Freeport ~25 mi. Concentrated in one industry.
P02.flood: MATERIAL. Brazoria County is coastal; Angleton sits on the Brazos floodplain and the county was hit hard by Harvey. Flood zone must be pulled per parcel.
P02.weather: Gulf coast - named-storm wind and surge; highest insurance of the Texas group
P02.liquidity: 62 days median on market; Zillow median list price $263,500 - this home asks $359,900, well above the local median
P02.notes: Median household income reported at $86,712 (homesnacks). Asking price sits ~37% above the town's median list price, which narrows the resale buyer pool.

P03.label: Dayton, TX 77535 (Liberty Co.)
P03.rent_note: No Dayton median obtained. Set at $2,000 by reference to the Conroe/Angleton band; assumption.
P03.university: Lee College (Baytown) ~20 mi; UH main ~35 mi
P03.jobs: Baytown/Mont Belvieu petrochemical ~20 mi; Grand Parkway industrial growth
P03.flood: Trinity River corridor - Liberty County has significant riverine flood history
P03.weather: Gulf-influenced; hurricane wind exposure inland of the coast
P03.notes: DRB markets River Ranch as 'the only premium builder offering the most personalization options under $300k' - yet this spec is listed at $357,990, roughly $30k above the Meyerson's $327,990 base.

P04.label: Crosby, TX 77532 (Harris Co.)
P04.rent_note: No Crosby median obtained. $2,100 by reference to comparable Harris County exurbs; assumption.
P04.university: Lee College ~15 mi; UH main ~25 mi
P04.jobs: Closest of the Texas group to central Houston employment; Ship Channel industry ~20 mi
P04.flood: San Jacinto River basin. Crosby is near the 2017 Arkema plant inundation site; flood zone check essential.
P04.notes: Lennar's Synova masterplan carries an open-air rec centre, trails, playgrounds, parks and lakes - the strongest amenity package in the set, which also implies a MUD.

P05.label: Cleburne, TX 76031 (Johnson Co.)
P05.rent_note: No Cleburne median obtained. $2,100 assumed; DFW-south exurb.
P05.university: Hill College in Cleburne; TCU ~30 mi
P05.airport: DFW ~50 mi; Fort Worth Alliance ~45 mi
P05.jobs: Fort Worth commuter belt ~30 mi; some Barnett Shale legacy
P05.weather: North Texas hail belt - the dominant insured peril
P05.notes: The only RESALE in the set, and the only one where the price has already been cut ($5k). No builder incentive or rate buydown will be available here, but the seller is a motivated individual rather than a builder - the one property where a genuinely below-market price is negotiable.

P06.label: Cut and Shoot, TX 77303 (Montgomery Co.)
P06.rent_note: Realtor.com gives the 77303 median rent as $1.8K/mo. Conroe city median $1.9K (+3.95% YoY); a 4-bed Conroe townhome averages $2,450. Median x 1.15 = $2,070.
P06.university: Lone Star College-Conroe ~8 mi; Sam Houston State (Huntsville) ~35 mi
P06.airport: IAH ~30 mi - best airport access in the set
P06.jobs: Conroe/Woodlands corridor is one of the strongest suburban job markets in Texas; The Woodlands ~20 mi
P06.flood: San Jacinto west fork and Lake Conroe releases - Montgomery County has real flood history
P06.schools: Conroe ISD - large, generally well-regarded district
P06.liquidity: Conroe home values $311,472, DOWN 1.0% YoY, ~70 days to pending - a softening sale market
P06.notes: Builder-direct price confirmed on Starlight's own site, the single highest-confidence price in the set. Starlight is Ashton Woods' entry-level brand - specification is value-engineered.

P07.label: Snook, TX 77878 (Burleson Co.)
P07.rent_note: Burleson County median rent $1.4K/mo (Realtor.com). x 1.15 = $1,610. The weakest rent in the set.
P07.university: Texas A&M, College Station ~20 mi - a genuine demand anchor
P07.airport: College Station (CLL) ~25 mi, regional only; IAH ~90 mi
P07.jobs: Texas A&M and the Bryan-College Station medical/education cluster
P07.weather: Central Texas - hail, drought, occasional freeze
P07.schools: Snook ISD - described as desirable locally
P07.liquidity: Burleson County: median list $302K, 79 days on market - the slowest market in the set
P07.notes: Least documented property. The A&M proximity is real but 20 miles is too far for student tenants, who concentrate within a few miles of campus.

P08.label: Lafayette, LA 70507 (Lafayette Parish)
P08.rent_note: No Lafayette median obtained. $1,800 assumed. Out-of-state and unverified.
P08.university: University of Louisiana at Lafayette - large campus in the city
P08.jobs: Oil-and-gas services, heavily cyclical with crude prices; healthcare
P08.flood: HIGH. Lafayette Parish flooded severely in August 2016 outside mapped high-risk zones.
P08.weather: Gulf coast hurricanes; Louisiana insurance market has hardened severely
P08.notes: This is a PLAN (Rosemont), not a specific house - there is nothing concrete to underwrite. Louisiana's low effective property tax is offset several times over by insurance.

P09.label: Needville, TX 77461 (Fort Bend Co.)
P09.rent_note: No Needville median obtained. $2,150 assumed on Fort Bend County strength.
P09.university: Wharton County JC ~25 mi; UH Sugar Land ~30 mi
P09.jobs: Fort Bend County is affluent and growing; Sugar Land employment ~30 mi
P09.flood: Brazos River basin - Fort Bend has repeated Brazos flooding history
P09.notes: Fort Bend County carries the heaviest MUD loads in the Houston area; 2.9% is assumed and it could be higher.

P10.label: Huffman, TX 77336 (Harris Co.)
P10.rent_note: No Huffman median obtained. $2,100 assumed, same basis as Crosby.
P10.university: Lee College ~20 mi; UH main ~30 mi
P10.jobs: Harris County; Ship Channel and Baytown industry within 25 mi
P10.flood: Lake Houston and San Jacinto east fork - Huffman has direct flood history
P10.notes: Still under construction, so rent does not start on completion of the purchase. Neighbouring Pescarola homes trade at $122-125/sqft.

P11.label: Lake Charles, LA 70607 (Calcasieu Parish)
P11.rent_note: No Lake Charles median obtained. $1,750 assumed. Out-of-state and unverified.
P11.university: McNeese State University in Lake Charles
P11.airport: Lake Charles Regional (LCH) ~10 mi, regional only
P11.jobs: LNG export and petrochemical construction - boom-and-bust, project-driven
P11.flood: VERY HIGH. Calcasieu Parish took direct hits from Hurricanes Laura and Delta in 2020.
P11.weather: The most hurricane-exposed location in the entire set
P11.notes: Builder identity unresolved between D.R. Horton and DSLD Homes. Redfin's D.R. Horton range tops out at 4 bedrooms and 2,079 sqft, so this may not even satisfy a 5-bedroom brief. DSLD advertises rates from 3.99% (6.788% APR) but only on FHA/RD/VA - none of which an investor can use.

P12.label: Caldwell, TX 77836 (Burleson Co.)
P12.rent_note: Zillow Rental Manager gives the Caldwell median rent as $1,500 across all bedroom counts; Burleson County median $1.4K. x 1.15 = $1,725.
P12.university: Texas A&M ~22 mi (Caldwell is 22 miles from Bryan/College Station)
P12.airport: College Station (CLL) ~25 mi, regional only; IAH ~95 mi
P12.jobs: County seat; A&M and Bryan-College Station commuting
P12.schools: Caldwell ISD - rated highly by Niche
P12.liquidity: Burleson County median list $302K, 79 days on market - slowest in the set
P12.notes: Median home value $215,100 against a ~$278k asking price. Niche notes 'most residents own their homes', which means a THIN rental pool - the vacancy assumption of 8% is probably optimistic here. Population only 12,670.
